lines.japanese: 「まだやり残してることはあるんです」
lines.english: “There are still things I haven't finished.”

lines.japanese: 「卒業文集の製作……まだ完成してないんです」
lines.english: “The graduation anthology... It still isn't complete.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、あれか……そうだなァ、さっき職員室に持っていった」
lines.english: “Ah, that... Right. I took it to the staff room a little while ago.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「けど、なァ、寄せ書きが終わってなきゃ完成とは言えないだろ。まだ二人分終わってねえんだよ」
lines.english: “But you can't call it finished until the class messages are done. Two people still haven't written theirs.”

lines.japanese: 「誰と誰、ですか」
lines.english: “Which two?”

lines.japanese: 「お前と明日香」
lines.english: “You and Asuka.”

lines.japanese: 針生さんは眼鏡のブリッジをくいと上げた。そのせいで、彼の表情が一瞬だけ見えなくなった。
lines.english: Hariu nudged up the bridge of his glasses. For an instant, the gesture hid his expression.

lines.japanese: 「渡来さんは、どうして」
lines.english: “Why hasn't Watarai...?”

lines.japanese: 「ハハ、そんなこと本人じゃなきゃ分かるはずがないでしょう。まあ、原稿とペンを渡しはしたんだけどなァ、断られたんだ。明日まで待ってくれとよ」
lines.english: “Ha ha. How could anybody but the lady herself know? I handed her the page and a pen, but she refused. Told me to wait until tomorrow.”

lines.japanese: 「それがどういうことか、分かるかい」
lines.english: “Do you understand what that means?”

lines.japanese: 「はい」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese: そうか、渡来さんはそのときには僕と話をしようって決めてくれてたんだ。
lines.english: Of course. By then, Watarai had already decided that she would speak to me.

lines.japanese: 「渡来さんと会いたいけど、でも……」
lines.english: “I want to see Watarai, but...”

lines.japanese: 「これから先は逃げ場所のない世界で生きていかなくちゃいけないのに、どうすればいいのか分からないし……」
lines.english: “From now on I have to live in a world with nowhere to run, and I don't know how...”

lines.japanese: 「渡来さんに会って、なにを言えばいいのか……」
lines.english: “If I see Watarai, I don't know what I could possibly say...”

lines.japanese: 僕は針生さんの顔を見ることが出来なかった。
lines.english: I could not look Hariu in the face.

lines.japanese: 現実から、自分から、渡来さんからも逃げてきた僕に何が出来るって言うんだろう。
lines.english: I had run from reality, from myself, and from Watarai. What could somebody like me possibly do?

lines.japanese: 「おれは今まで……逃げることしかしてこなかったんです」
lines.english: “All I've ever done... is run away.”

lines.japanese: 何だろう、この感情は。自分の中に今まで覚えたことのない気持ちが込みあげてきた。
lines.english: What was this feeling? Something I had never felt before was welling up inside me.

lines.japanese: 針生さんの視線が止まっていた。いつも獲物を狙うように動いている彼の目が、いまは僕に向けられている。
lines.english: Hariu's gaze had gone still. His eyes, forever roving like a predator's in search of prey, were fixed on me now.

lines.japanese: 「ふむ、おまえは逃避と言うが果たしてそうかな」
lines.english: “Hmm. You call it escape, but I wonder if that's truly what it was.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「昨日の答えを教えてやるよ。明日香はこう言ったんだ」
lines.english: “I'll give you the answer to yesterday's question. This is what Asuka said.”

lines.japanese: 針生さんは鞄からペットボトルを取りだそうとして、さっきの一本でなくなってしまったことに気づくと、軽く舌打ちをした。
lines.english: Hariu reached into his bag for a plastic bottle, remembered that the last one had been emptied, and clicked his tongue softly.

lines.japanese: 「自分の中に閉じこもるのは、逃避じゃなくて探索だと」
lines.english: “Retreating into yourself isn’t escape. It’s exploration.”

lines.japanese: 「現実から離れても、そこからなにか持ちかえってこられるなら、決してその世界は無駄ではないってな」
lines.english: “Even if you leave reality behind, that world is never a waste if you can bring something back from it.”

lines.japanese: さっき渡来さんが同じことを言っていた。大切なのはなにを持ちかえるか。
lines.english: Watarai had said the same thing earlier. What mattered was what you brought back.

lines.japanese: 「もう一度思い出してみなよ。明日香がなにを言ったのか」
lines.english: “Think back once more. Remember what Asuka told you.”

lines.japanese: 「渡来さんがおれに言ったこと」
lines.english: “What Watarai told me...”

lines.japanese: この世界で過ごすために、僕はずっとグレタガルドに救いを求めてきた。あそこに居れば、誰もが僕を称えてくれるから、自分を誇ることが出来たんだ。
lines.english: To endure this world, I had always sought salvation in Gretagard. Everyone praised me there, and so I could take pride in myself.

lines.japanese: どうして僕はあの世界に憧れていたんだろう。僕が勇者でいられるからだろうか。
lines.english: Why had I longed for that world? Because I could be a hero there?

lines.japanese: 渡来さんはどうして逃げていたんだろう。なんで逃げたいと思ったんだろう。
lines.english: Why had Watarai run away? What had made her want to escape?

lines.japanese: それはきっと、この世界が素晴らしいことだけで満ちているわけじゃないからだ。
lines.english: Surely it was because this world wasn’t filled only with wonderful things.

lines.japanese: 僕は嫌なことがあると、グレタガルドに行くことで目を瞑ってきたのかもしれない。
lines.english: Whenever something hurt, perhaps I had traveled to Gretagard so that I could close my eyes to it.

lines.japanese: だけど、本当は向きあわなくちゃいけないんだ。それをドラゴンの戦いや洞窟での冒険に置きかえることで、僕は現実から目をそむけてきただけなんだ。
lines.english: But in truth, those were the very things I had to face. By turning them into battles with dragons and adventures in caves, I had only turned my eyes away from reality.

lines.japanese: 「渡来さんは……なにを持ってかえってきたんでしょう」
lines.english: “What do you think Watarai brought back?”

lines.japanese: 「さあなァ、そんなことまで話すようなやつじゃないしなァ」
lines.english: “Who knows? She's not the sort to tell me that much.”

lines.japanese: 「ただ、そうだな、おまえは……自分の中に閉じこもらなくなってから、何が変わった」
lines.english: “But let's see. You... What changed after you stopped shutting yourself away inside?”

lines.japanese: 「グレタガルドに行かなくなってから……」
lines.english: “After I stopped going to Gretagard...”

lines.japanese: それは、この世界でやることが出来たからだ。
lines.english: It was because I had found things to do in this world.

lines.japanese: やることいっぱい見つけたんだ。卒業文集、受験勉強、それに渡来さんと遊んだり。
lines.english: So many things. The graduation anthology, studying for my entrance exams, spending time with Watarai.

lines.japanese: グレタガルドに行けなくなったんじゃない、行く必要がなくなったんだ。
lines.english: It wasn't that I had lost the ability to go to Gretagard. I had lost the need.

lines.japanese: 「少なくとも俺には、なァ、いまのおまえと明日香にそれほど差があるとは思えねえな」
lines.english: “At least to me, you know... there doesn't seem to be all that much difference between you now and Asuka.”

lines.japanese: 「おれと渡来さんは同じ……」
lines.english: “Watarai and I are the same...”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんは僕の中でいつも輝いてた。それなら彼女から見た僕はどうなんだろう。
lines.english: Watarai had always shone in my eyes. Then what did I look like in hers?

lines.japanese: 「渡来さんには……翼があるんでしょうか」
lines.english: “Does Watarai... have wings?”

lines.japanese: 「おまえそんなもんが見えんのか」
lines.english: “You can see things like that?”

lines.japanese: ない。誰の背中にも翼なんてない。この空に飛びたつことなんて出来やしない。
lines.english: No. Nobody had wings on their back. None of us could ever take flight into this sky.

lines.japanese: 「だって私もそうだったから！」
lines.english: “Because I was the same!”

lines.japanese: 「渡来さんは、おれのことを救おうとしてくれたのに……おれは彼女が」
lines.english: “Watarai tried to save me, and yet I... She...”

lines.japanese: 「渡来さんは自分だって悲しいのに！」
lines.english: “Even though Watarai herself is hurting!”

lines.japanese: 「はン、どうだか」
lines.english: “Hah. Who can say?”

lines.japanese: 手を握り締めた僕を見て、針生さんは子どもをあやすような口ぶりで軽く笑う。
lines.english: When he saw my hands clench, Hariu laughed softly in the tone one might use to soothe a child.

lines.japanese: 「案外いまは幸せなのかもなァ。まァ、あいつにだってそれくらいの権利はあンだろ」
lines.english: “She might be surprisingly happy right now. Well, she's got at least that much right to happiness.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、どういうことですか？」
lines.english: “What do you mean?”

lines.japanese: 「考えろよ。お坊さんじゃあるまいし、明日香だって義理や人情で人助けなんかしないでしょう」
lines.english: “Think about it. She's no Buddhist monk. Asuka doesn't go around saving people out of duty and human kindness.”

lines.japanese: 「あヤベ。俺あとで明日香に文句言われるかもなァ、ハハ、まああとはおまえらだけで適当にやってよ」
lines.english: “Ah, damn. Asuka might chew me out later. Ha ha. Well, the rest is between the two of you. Do what you like.”

lines.japanese: 針生さんの視線がまたさまよい始める。きっと、僕と話すことがもうなくなったんだろう。
lines.english: Hariu's gaze began to wander again. He must have had nothing left to discuss with me.

lines.japanese: 「針生さん、おれ、渡来さんに謝ってきます」
lines.english: “Hariu, I'm going to apologize to Watarai.”

lines.japanese: 僕はまだ少し湿る前髪を掻き揚げて、顔をぺぺしと二回叩いた。
lines.english: I swept back my still-damp bangs and gave my cheeks two brisk pats.

lines.japanese: 「今から行って謝ってきます。それで、自分の言いたいことを全部伝えてきます」
lines.english: “I'm going now to apologize. Then I'll tell her everything I want to say.”

lines.japanese: 「ハハ」
lines.english: “Ha ha.”

lines.japanese: 針生さんがのっそりと一歩近づいてくる。上体が前かがみになって表情が分かりにくかったけど、いつものうっすらとした笑顔を浮かべているように見えた。
lines.english: Hariu lumbered one step closer. He was bent forward, making his expression hard to read, but I thought I could see his customary thin smile.

lines.japanese: 「違うだろ、おまえは謝るんじゃない、やつに礼を言うんだ」
lines.english: “Wrong. You're not going there to apologize. You're going to thank her.”

lines.japanese: 「針生さん……」
lines.english: “Hariu...”

lines.japanese: 「俺の蹴りを食らったときのおまえはいいツラしてたぜ」
lines.english: “You had a damn good look on your face when you took my kick.”

lines.japanese: 「ナイスロックだったぜェ、羽田」
lines.english: “Now that was rock, Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 「ロック……」
lines.english: “Rock...”

lines.japanese: 針生さんが何度か言っていたロックって言葉。そうか、ロックってのは、音楽だけじゃないんだ。
lines.english: Rock. Hariu had used that word several times. Of course. Rock was more than music.

lines.japanese: なんてかっこいい響きなんだろう。俺はいま、針生さんにロックだと認めてもらえたんだ。
lines.english: What a cool sound. Hariu had acknowledged me as rock.

lines.japanese: 「おれ……ロックになれましたか」
lines.english: “Did I... become rock?”

lines.japanese: 「Ｗｅ　ｃａｌｌ　ｙｏｕ“Ｒｏｃｋ”．さ、行けよ。日が暮れるぞ」
lines.english: “We call you 'Rock.' Now get going. The sun's going down.”

lines.japanese: 彼は顎をくいと動かした。
lines.english: He jerked his chin toward the road.

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう」
lines.english: “Thank you.”

lines.japanese: オレンジ色よりも少し灰がかった、青春ドラマには似合わない冬の夕暮れ。
lines.english: The winter dusk was a little grayer than orange, the wrong color for a youth drama.

lines.japanese: 水柿なんていう色の名前があるらしい。そんな空の下、僕は渡来さんのマンションに向かって駆けだした。
lines.english: Apparently that color had a name: pale persimmon. Beneath that sky, I broke into a run toward Watarai’s apartment.

lines.japanese: 「羽田……おまえのお蔭で俺も卒業する気になったよ」
lines.english: “Haneda... Thanks to you, I think I'll graduate after all.”

lines.japanese: 走りはじめた直後に、針生さんの独りごちるような声が聞こえた。
lines.english: Just after I began to run, I heard Hariu murmur as though speaking to himself.

lines.japanese: 「さあて探索行って来るか……バーベナ学園に……」
lines.english: “Well, then. Guess I'll go exploring... at Verbena Academy...”

lines.japanese: だけどすぐに距離が離れたから、最後まで聞きとることは出来なかった。
lines.english: But the distance between us opened almost at once, and I could not hear the rest.

lines.japanese: この少しの時間に僕は色んなことがあったっていうのに、マンションはなにも変わらず、街の生活の中に馴染んでいた。
lines.english: So much had happened to me in that little span of time. Yet the apartment building had not changed at all; it stood absorbed in the ordinary life of the city.

lines.japanese: あまりに僕が飛びだしたときと変わらないから、自分の気持ちまで時間が戻ってしまいそうだ。
lines.english: It looked so exactly as it had when I ran out that I felt my heart might turn back in time with it.

lines.japanese: でも電気の点いていない渡来さんの部屋を見ると、少しだけ勇気が湧いた。
lines.english: But when I saw no light in Watarai's room, a little courage rose inside me.

lines.japanese: 僕はエレベーターに乗って、何度か訪れた彼女の部屋へと向かう。
lines.english: I took the elevator to the apartment I had visited several times now.

lines.japanese: ドアノブに手をかけてゆっくり回してみると、僕の手の動きは遮られることはなかった。
lines.english: I set a hand on the doorknob and slowly turned it. It turned freely.

lines.japanese: 無用心なんてのは、何も言わずに飛びだした僕が言えることじゃない。僕はそっと扉の隙間に体を割りこませた。
lines.english: After running out without a word, I had no right to call her careless. Quietly, I slipped my body through the gap in the door.

lines.japanese: ノックをした方がいいかなと思ったけど、出てきてくれないと困るので、勝手に上がらせてもらうことにする。
lines.english: I wondered whether I ought to knock, but it would be a problem if she refused to come out, so I took the liberty of entering.

lines.japanese: 家の中はさっき僕が訪れたときのままで、カーテンも開けはなたれていた。
lines.english: Inside, everything remained as it had been when I visited earlier. Even the curtains still stood wide open.

lines.japanese: 「渡来さん……」
lines.english: “Watarai...”

lines.japanese: 彼女はベッドに横になっていた。
lines.english: She lay on the bed.

lines.japanese: 何かを悔やんでいるかのように。何かを悲しんでいるかのように。
lines.english: As though she regretted something. As though she grieved for something.

lines.japanese: でもやることは全てやったあとの疲れのように。
lines.english: Yet also as though she were simply exhausted after doing everything there was to do.

lines.japanese: 窓から射しこむ夕日が眩しいのか、彼女の目は両腕で覆いかくされていた。
lines.english: Perhaps the sunset pouring through the window was too bright. She had hidden her eyes beneath both arms.

lines.japanese: でもそのおかげで、その顔の作りが、輪郭線、鼻筋、唇、全てにおいて完璧なことがよく分かった。
lines.english: But that only made the perfection of her face easier to see: its outline, the bridge of her nose, her lips—every part of it.

lines.japanese: 彼女は、意識して表情を作らなくても本当に整った顔をしていた。
lines.english: Even when she was not consciously composing an expression, her face was truly beautiful.

lines.japanese: 普段の彼女は綺麗だ。見とれてしまうくらい綺麗だ。だけど、いま見ている人間臭い渡来さんが、今までで一番愛らしいと思った。
lines.english: Ordinarily, Watarai was beautiful. Beautiful enough to hold me spellbound. Yet Watarai as she was now, so openly human, seemed more lovable than I had ever seen her.

lines.japanese: 僕はその唇に見とれつつ、頭の上から話すのはいくらなんでも失礼だと思って、ベッドの足元まで移動した。
lines.english: I stared at her lips, then decided that speaking from above her head would be inexcusably rude and moved to the foot of the bed.

lines.japanese: 「……なにようだ」
lines.english: “...What do you want?”

lines.japanese: 水柿色の世界の中、彼女の瑞々しい唇が、上等のゼリーみたいにふるんと揺れた。
lines.english: In a world of pale persimmon, her dewy lips quivered like the finest jelly.

lines.japanese: 「気づいてたんだ」
lines.english: “You knew I was here.”

lines.japanese: 「当たり前だよね」
lines.english: “Of course I did, right?”

lines.japanese: 彼女は独り言のように呟く。いや、もしかしたらそれは独り言じゃなくて……。
lines.english: She murmured it as though to herself. Or perhaps those words had not been addressed to herself at all...

lines.japanese: 「当たり前だよ」
lines.english: “Of course I did.”

lines.japanese: ……やっぱり言いなおした。
lines.english: ...Just as I thought. She had corrected herself.

lines.japanese: 彼女はきっと、昔いた、彼女の友達のことをずっと引きずってたんだ。そこから踏みだした第一歩が呼びかけないことなんだと思う。
lines.english: She must have carried her old friend with her all this time. Perhaps the first step forward from that past was not calling out to him anymore.

lines.japanese: 僕は彼女の足先にぺたんこ座りで腰を下ろす。
lines.english: I sat down flat on the floor at her feet.

lines.japanese: 「鍵はかけなよ」
lines.english: “You should lock your door.”

lines.japanese: 僕は本題とはかけ離れた話題を投げかける。気づかない振りをした渡来さんといい、お互い臆病だ。
lines.english: I tossed out a subject far removed from what I had come to say. She had pretended not to notice me arriving, and now I was avoiding the issue. We were both cowards.

lines.japanese: 「……かけないよ」
lines.english: “...I won't.”

lines.japanese: 「戻ってきてくれたとき入れないじゃん」
lines.english: “You wouldn't be able to come in when you came back.”

lines.japanese: そして今日も、先に一歩踏み出してきたのは渡来さんだった。
lines.english: And today again, Watarai was the first to take a step forward.

lines.japanese: 「はは、確かに困ってたかも。渡来さんの言うとおりだね」
lines.english: “Ha ha. Yes, I might have been in trouble. You were right.”

lines.japanese: 「遅いよ」
lines.english: “You're late.”

lines.japanese: 「ん……ごめん」
lines.english: “Mm... I'm sorry.”

lines.japanese: 「ほんとはそんなに遅くなかったかも。いろいろ考える時間が欲しかったし」
lines.english: “Maybe you weren't that late after all. I wanted some time to think about everything.”

lines.japanese: 「どんなこと？」
lines.english: “About what?”

lines.japanese: 「おとぎの国のこと」
lines.english: “Fairyland.”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんにかかる光に一瞬だけ影が差した。きっと、夕日に雲がかかったんだ。
lines.english: For an instant, a shadow crossed the light falling over Watarai. A cloud must have passed across the setting sun.

lines.japanese: 「誰でも知ってるおとぎ話ってあるよね」
lines.english: “There's a fairy tale everybody knows, isn't there?”

lines.japanese: 「大人になったら行けなくなる、子どもだけの国の話。そんな話にずっと憧れてた」
lines.english: “A land only children can visit, a land you can never reach again once you grow up. I always longed for a story like that.”

lines.japanese: 「でもきっと、子どもたちは自分が大人になるなんて考えないんだよ。だからずっとその世界に居られると思っちゃうの」
lines.english: “But children probably never imagine that they themselves will grow up. So they believe they can stay in that world forever.”

lines.japanese: 「私もそう。少なくともキュウリが食べられるようになってからは、子どもの国には行けなくなった」
lines.english: “I was the same. At least, after I learned to eat cucumbers, I couldn't go to the children's land anymore.”

lines.japanese: 「はは、渡来さんもキュウリが駄目なんだ。おれもだよ」
lines.english: “Ha ha. You can’t eat cucumbers either? Neither can I.”

lines.japanese: 「今は食べられる」
lines.english: “I can eat them now.”

lines.japanese: ベッドの向こう側で、小さい息の音が聞こえた。
lines.english: A tiny breath sounded from the far side of the bed.

lines.japanese: 「でもキュウリの食べられない羽田君は、おとぎの国に飛びたてた」
lines.english: “But you still couldn't eat cucumbers, Haneda. You could fly away to fairyland.”

lines.japanese: 「行けるひとが、ずっと羨ましかった」
lines.english: “I always envied the people who could go.”

lines.japanese: 「最初はそれで羽田君をずっと見てた」
lines.english: “At first, that was why I kept watching you.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、知ってたの？」
lines.english: “What? You knew?”

lines.japanese: 「ううん、ただの勘。確信を持ったのは、ほんと最近」
lines.english: “No. It was only a hunch. I didn't become sure until very recently.”

lines.japanese: 「でもいつの間にかそんなの関係なくなってた」
lines.english: “But before I knew it, none of that mattered anymore.”

lines.japanese: 胸が昂った。
lines.english: My heart soared.

lines.japanese: ずっと仮面彼女だと思ってた、僕の初恋の人。
lines.english: My first love—the girl I had always thought was only my pretend girlfriend.

lines.japanese: 出来すぎた話だと笑いながら、甘い戸惑いを覚えた胸の奥。その感覚がじわりと蘇ってきた。
lines.english: The sweet bewilderment I had felt deep in my chest, even as I laughed at a story too perfect to be true, slowly returned.

lines.japanese: 「待って」
lines.english: “Wait.”

lines.japanese: これ以上は僕から言わなくちゃいけない。
lines.english: From here on, I had to be the one to speak.

lines.japanese: だって彼女は全然そうは見えないけど、とっても臆病なおんなのこなんだから。
lines.english: Because although she never looked it, she was a terribly timid girl.

lines.japanese: 「さっきは飛びだしちゃったけど」
lines.english: “I ran out before, but...”

lines.japanese: 僕は彼女のベッドに縁べりに手をかけて、上体を起こす。
lines.english: I placed a hand on the edge of her bed and raised myself up.

lines.japanese: 「ここに来るまでの間にいろいろ考えたんだ」
lines.english: “On my way here, I thought about all sorts of things.”

lines.japanese: 「グレタガルドの世界の住人たちは、いつも逃げてばかりの、おれの心を映したひとたちだったんだ」
lines.english: “The people of Gretagard reflected my own heart—the heart of someone who was always running away.”

lines.japanese: 「だから自分の理想像の英雄に、自分の都合のいい世界で救いを求めてた」
lines.english: “So I sought salvation in my ideal image of a hero, inside a world arranged for my own convenience.”

lines.japanese: 「でもその逃げ場がなくなったから、今度はこの世界からも逃げだそうとした」
lines.english: “But when I lost that refuge, I tried to run away from this world too.”

lines.japanese: 僕は立ちあがると、ゆっくりとベッドの上に被さり、両手で這いながら前へ進んだ。
lines.english: I rose, slowly leaned over the bed, and crept forward on both hands.

lines.japanese: 「自分の存在がこの世界からなくなろうとしてるのに、誰もおれを助けてくれないんだと思ってた」
lines.english: “Even as my existence was about to vanish from this world, I believed nobody would save me.”

lines.japanese: 「でも渡来さんが教えてくれた。自分と同じだって」
lines.english: “But you taught me, Watarai. You told me you were the same.”

lines.japanese: 「だから気がついたよ」
lines.english: “And then I understood.”

lines.japanese: 「これはきっと何処にでもある、ありふれた物語なんだ」
lines.english: “This must be an ordinary story—the kind that happens everywhere.”

lines.japanese: 「おれはちょっと夢見がちなところがあって、嫌なことがあるとすぐに自分の殻に閉じこもっちゃうんだ」
lines.english: “I'm a little too given to dreams, and whenever something hurts, I shut myself away inside my shell.”

lines.japanese: 「それに心の病気があるから、ちゃんと病院に行って、長い時間がかかっても、向きあって治していかなくちゃいけない」
lines.english: “And because I have an illness of the mind, I need to go to a hospital and face it, however long that takes, and work toward getting better.”

lines.japanese: 「だけどそれだけの普通の男の子なんだ」
lines.english: “But that's all. I'm only an ordinary boy.”

lines.japanese: 「もう逃げないよ」
lines.english: “I won't run anymore.”

lines.japanese: 体の血液が全て上ってきたんじゃないかってくらい顔中が熱くなって、頬を何かが伝っていった。
lines.english: My entire face burned as though every drop of blood in my body had rushed into it. Something traced a path down my cheek.

lines.japanese: 今まで悔しくても、悲しくても、涙なんて一度も流したことがなかった。
lines.english: No matter how bitter or sad things became, I had never shed a single tear.

lines.japanese: いや、悔しいとも悲しいとも思わないようにしていたんだ。認めてしまうのが怖かったから。
lines.english: No. I had refused even to feel bitterness or sadness. I was afraid to admit them.

lines.japanese: 「渡来さん、ありがとう」
lines.english: “Thank you, Watarai.”

lines.japanese: 彼女には見えないけど、僕は笑顔を作ろうとした。
lines.english: She could not see it, but I tried to smile.

lines.japanese: あれ、おかしいな。上手く笑えないや。はは、涙が止まらない。
lines.english: Huh. That was strange. I couldn't manage it. Ha ha. The tears would not stop.

lines.japanese: 僕の顔から落ちた涙が、ぽつぽつと渡来さんの腕にかかった。
lines.english: Tears fell from my face one by one and pattered against Watarai's arms.

lines.japanese: 「さっきといい、みっともないところ見せちゃったな……挽回できるといいんだけど」
lines.english: “Between this and earlier, I’ve made a pretty sorry sight... I hope I can make up for it.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだと」
lines.english: “What did you say?”

lines.japanese: 僕の顔の下で、渡来さんが声を出した。
lines.english: Watarai's voice rose from beneath my face.

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「これ以上の挽回なんかどうやってするの」
lines.english: “How could you possibly make up for it any more than this?”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんの口が横にきゅっと結ばれている。気がつけば、顔を覆う手が握られていた。
lines.english: Watarai's mouth had pressed into a tight line. At some point, the hands covering her face had clenched into fists.

lines.japanese: 「おれ、がんばるよ」
lines.english: “I'll do my best.”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんがこくんこくんと何度もうなずく。
lines.english: Watarai nodded again and again.

lines.japanese: 変わらなくちゃ。
lines.english: I had to change.

lines.japanese: 僕の影に覆われる渡来さんを見て、強くそう思った。
lines.english: Looking at Watarai covered by my shadow, I felt that with all my heart.

lines.japanese: 目の前の魅力的なゼリーがふるんと揺れた。
lines.english: The enticing jelly before me gave a soft quiver.

lines.japanese: 彼女の口から漏れる吐息は、音まで甘い響きを持っているような気がした。
lines.english: Even the breath escaping her lips seemed sweet to the ear.

lines.japanese: 熱い感情で火照った体は、甘い響きに簡単に溶けた。
lines.english: My body, already fevered with emotion, melted easily into that sweetness.

lines.japanese: 僕はゆっくりと顔を沈めていく。
lines.english: Slowly, I lowered my face.

lines.japanese: 「あのさ、おれももうおとぎの国は卒業するよ」
lines.english: “You know, I'm going to graduate from fairyland too.”

lines.japanese: 「だっておれ、キュウリは食べられるようになったんだ」
lines.english: “Because I've learned to eat cucumbers now.”

lines.japanese: 「きゅうっ……」
lines.english: “Cucu—”

lines.japanese: 彼女の口がタイミングよくすぼまったので、僕は渡来さんの腕を顔から外して、その上から素早く唇を重ねた。
lines.english: Her mouth pursed at exactly the right moment. I drew Watarai's arms away from her face and quickly pressed my lips over hers.

lines.japanese: 渡来さんの顔を見ていたかったけど、僕も初めての体験なので、キスする瞬間に目を瞑ってしまった。
lines.english: I wanted to watch Watarai's face, but this was my first time too, and at the instant we kissed, my eyes fell shut.

lines.japanese: でも僕の唇に柔らかな二つの隆起が当たっていたから、場所は間違えてないと思う。しゃべるように唇を小さく動かすと、隆起の谷間にある隙間が、きゅっと締まった。
lines.english: But two soft curves met my lips, so I believed I had found the right place. When I moved my lips a little, as though speaking, the narrow opening in the valley between those curves tightened.

lines.japanese: そっと目を開くと、そこには渡来さんの綺麗な瞳が――
lines.english: I gently opened my eyes. There were Watarai's beautiful eyes—
“Wh—”
“Mm?”

lines.japanese: 「なんでっ！？」
lines.english: “Why!?”

lines.japanese: 綺麗な瞳が――まんまるに膨らんでいた。
lines.english: Her beautiful eyes—had gone perfectly round.

lines.japanese: 「い、いいいいきなり何～！？」
lines.english: “Wh-wh-wh-what was that out of nowhere?!”

lines.japanese: 驚いた表情が面白い。あの渡来明日香が動揺してる。
lines.english: Her astonishment was delightful. Asuka Watarai herself had lost her composure.

lines.japanese: 「え、いや、気持ちが暴発しちゃって……」
lines.english: “Well, my feelings sort of... misfired...”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君は気持ちが暴発したらキスするのっ？」
lines.english: “You kiss people whenever your feelings misfire?!”

lines.japanese: 「そういう日も」
lines.english: “Some days.”

lines.japanese: 「ないよっ！」
lines.english: “There are no such days!”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんはぶんっと首を一回横に振った。その動きに従うように、長い髪がさらりと揺れる。
lines.english: Watarai whipped her head once from side to side. Her long hair followed in a silken sweep.

lines.japanese: 「あのね、こう見えて、おれもそれなりに覚悟とか緊張とかしてたわけなんだけど」
lines.english: “Listen, I may not look it, but that took some resolve. I was pretty nervous too.”

lines.japanese: 「え、えええ～、なんで私、心の準備もなくいきなり乙女の純潔を奪われたあとに怒られてるの。二重の意味でびっくりだよ」
lines.english: “W-why am I being scolded right after you stole a maiden's purity without giving her any time to prepare? I'm shocked in two different ways.”

lines.japanese: 「やだなあ、怒ってはないよ、あはは」
lines.english: “Oh, come on. I'm not angry. Ahaha.”

lines.japanese: 「このひと成長してない……」
lines.english: “This man hasn't grown at all...”

lines.japanese: さっき重ねたばかりの唇から吐息が漏れた。でもそれは、呆れというには相応しくない、高い温度を持っているのが伝わってくる。
lines.english: A breath escaped the lips I had kissed only moments ago. Yet I could feel too much heat in it for mere exasperation.

lines.japanese: 「ていうか」
lines.english: “Besides...”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんは驚いたままの表情で、少しだけ眉を八の字に持ち上げた。
lines.english: Still wearing her astonishment, Watarai lifted her brows into a slight plaintive arch.

lines.japanese: 「それでも嬉しい私ってどうなの」
lines.english: “And what does it say about me that I'm happy anyway?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 今度は僕の方が動揺した。その隙を突いてくるかのように、渡来さんの表情にいつものまっすぐさが戻る。
lines.english: Now it was my turn to lose my composure. As though seizing that opening, Watarai's usual directness returned to her face.

lines.japanese: 「うん、今のは今ので一生の記念として残しとく」
lines.english: “Mm-hm. I'll take that one as it was and keep it as a memory for life.”

lines.japanese: 「よし、今度は覚悟が出来たぞ。次も一生の記念を残して」
lines.english: “All right. Now I'm ready. Give me another memory to last a lifetime.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、次？」
lines.english: “What? Another?”

lines.japanese: 僕は続けて動揺した。渡来さんから求められるとは思ってなかったからだ。
lines.english: I was shaken all over again. I had never expected Watarai to ask me for it.

lines.japanese: 「ん……うん。だってあんまりびっくりしたから、頭の中が真っ白になっちゃって、せっかくの瞬間を全然覚えてないんだもん。明日香さん、完全に羽田君にやられちゃった」
lines.english: “Mm... yes. I was so surprised that my mind went completely blank. I don't remember that precious moment at all. Asuka has been utterly vanquished by Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 「だから今度はきちんと思い出に残したいんだよ。初めてのキスだもん」
lines.english: “So this time I want to remember it properly. It was my first kiss.”

lines.japanese: 「は、初めてなんだ」
lines.english: “Y-your first?”

lines.japanese: 「なんだと。何故そこで驚く」
lines.english: “What did you say? Why would that surprise you?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、だ、だって、渡来さん綺麗だし……」
lines.english: “B-because you're beautiful...”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そんなこと真顔で言わないで。だって私、羽田君一筋だったでしょ」
lines.english: “D-don’t say something like that with such a serious face. I’ve only ever had eyes for you, remember?”

lines.japanese: 羽田君一筋。こんなこと、冗談以外で言われる日が来るなんて思わなかった。
lines.english: She’d only ever had eyes for me. I had never imagined the day would come when someone said such a thing to me without joking.

lines.japanese: 「うん、そうだよね。分かった、今度はちゃんとやるよ」
lines.english: “Mm-hm. Of course. All right. This time I'll do it properly.”

lines.japanese: 「うん来て」
lines.english: “Mm-hm. Come here.”

lines.japanese: 「でもその前に」
lines.english: “But before that...”
“Hm?”

lines.japanese: これから僕は変わろう。変わっていこう。そのための、第一歩。
lines.english: From now on, I would change. I would keep changing. This would be the first step.

lines.japanese: 「渡来さん、改めてお願いします。おれと付き合ってください」
lines.english: “Watarai, let me ask you again, properly. Will you be my girlfriend?”

lines.japanese: 彼女との関係も変えていこう。もう仮初の付き合いじゃない。本当の恋人。
lines.english: What lay between us would change too. No more pretending. We would be a real couple.

lines.japanese: 「ていうか、ねえ。そんな嬉しいこと言わないで。落ちた」
lines.english: “Please... don’t say anything that makes me that happy. I’m done for.”

lines.japanese: 「受験前に落ちたなんて言わないでよ」
lines.english: “Don’t say that with the entrance exams coming up.”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんの表情が少し和らいだ。僕はその肩に両手を添える。
lines.english: Watarai's expression softened a little. I placed both hands on her shoulders.

lines.japanese: 「羽田君、改めて返事するね」
lines.english: “Haneda, let me answer you again, properly.”

lines.japanese: 「いいよ」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese: 小さな体が微かに震えていたけど、僕の手だって震えているに違いない。
lines.english: Her small body trembled faintly, but my hands must have been trembling too.

lines.japanese: 数秒かそれ以上の時間か、しばらく見つめあったあと渡来さんの目がすっと閉じられた。
lines.english: For several seconds, perhaps longer, we gazed at one another. Then Watarai's eyes slipped quietly closed.

lines.japanese: 僕は今度こそ目を開いて、彼女の唇に触れあわせた。
lines.english: This time I kept my eyes open and touched my lips to hers.

lines.japanese: 彼女の言うとおりだ。さっきのキスは感情の中にしか残っていない抒情詩だ。僕たちの物語はここから始まる。
lines.english: She had been right. That first kiss was a lyric poem preserved only in emotion. Our story began here.

lines.japanese: 肩に置いた手を腕に沿って下ろしていく。
lines.english: My hands descended from her shoulders, following the line of her arms.

lines.japanese: 二の腕の位置までくると、そのまま背中へと巻きつけた。
lines.english: When they reached her upper arms, I slipped them around her back.

lines.japanese: 抱きしめた彼女の体はあまりにも細くて、僕のイメージを遥かに超えたリアライズが伝わってきた。
lines.english: The body I embraced was so slender that the reality of it surpassed anything I had imagined.
